author: Mark Atwood
text: Research complete (2026-08-28, live web sources). TIER 1 - APPLY: (1) NLnet/NGI Zero->Open Internet Stack: calls reopen 2026-09-03, deadline 2026-11-03 12:00 CEST; typical grants 5k-50k EUR; LICHEN is a textbook fit (open IETF standards, GPL-3.0/CC-BY, privacy tech, decentralized networking). (2) ARDC (ardc.net): ROLLING applications via contact@ardc.net; 2026 grantees include GBARC Meshtastic Network Expansion $1,383 and Sacramento Valley LoRa Mesh Enhancement $1,656, plus R&D grants up to $258k (GNU Radio 4); hardware+travel for a 500-node ham-adjacent LoRa mesh is squarely in their lane - needs amateur-radio/education framing. TIER 2 - MODERATE: (3) OTF Internet Freedom Fund (rolling): frame as censorship-resistant off-grid comms; conference deployment is a weaker narrative than their usual portfolio. (4) ISOC Foundation BOLT/Research: decent technical fit but likely requires org/chapter eligibility - verify before investing. EXCLUDED: Shuttleworth - FOUNDATION DEFUNCT, shuttleworthfoundation.org now serves an unrelated Mauritius football-club project (Digiclub, reg. 2024); Mozilla MOSS/Builders ended, no active program; EFF is not an external grantmaker; Sovereign Tech Fund site unreachable at research time - verify manually. TIMELINE RE-ANCHOR: DEFCON 2026 (Aug) has passed; NLnet Nov 3 deadline funds projects starting ~Q1-Q2 2027 -> targets CCC 2026 (Dec) for a dry run and DEFCON 34 (Aug 2027) as the flagship.
